findings.label: Missing batch-on-complete handler tests
findings.description: Tests reference catalog-batch-processing-flow but don't test the batch completion trigger (on-complete section) that invokes downstream delisting, CDN invalidation, and finalization subflows. Test-40 attempts integration but only validates the intake orchestrator. The batch processor's on-complete callback is untested.

findings.label: No schema initialization failure scenario coverage
findings.description: Test-44 mocks db:execute-ddl to succeed, but no test covers DB:CONNECTIVITY, DB:QUERY_EXECUTION, or other transient failures during schema setup. Critical startup path has zero failure-case coverage.

findings.label: CDN retry logic incomplete
findings.description: Tests mock single HTTP failures but don't validate until-successful retry counts, backoff timing, or max-attempts termination. Test-25 (retry exhausted) and test-22/23 (429/CONNECTIVITY) don't verify that retries actually occur; they only verify that errors are mocked.

findings.label: Global error handler HTTP propagation untested
findings.description: Tests-31 through test-39 use http:request with error-response-handler, but this doesn't actually test whether errors from nested processors propagate through APIKit and the error handler to HTTP response. The tests mock direct flow-refs instead of invoking through the HTTP listener and router.

findings.label: Transaction rollback on persistence failure untested
findings.description: Persistence tests mock successful db:insert/update, but no test triggers a failure mid-persistence (e.g., db:insert succeeds but history insert fails) to verify rollback or compensating transaction behavior. until-successful wrapping may hide failures.

findings.label: Delisting edge case: exact boundary at fetch limit untested
findings.description: Delisting tests return hardcoded results, but no test validates behavior when the database cursor exactly hits batch size limits or pagination boundaries during the absent-product scan.

findings.label: CDN batch dispatch with empty paths list untested
findings.description: Tests set currentBatchPaths but no test covers the case where the list is empty or null before dispatch. Pre-condition validation is not tested.

findings.label: Correlation ID propagation in batch on-complete untested
findings.description: Test-45 checks correlation ID in error response for HTTP, but no test validates that correlationId flows through batch on-complete into delisting, CDN, and finalization subflows.
